title: AttackHistory
description: A history record of attack data.

id.description: The unique identifier for the attack history record.

source.description: The source of the clan data, either from Discord or web.

clanid.description: The unique ID of the clan.

membersource.description: The source of the member data, either from Discord or web.

memberid.description: The unique ID of the user.

messageid.description: The message ID related to the attack.

attacklap.description: The boss lap when the attack started.

overtime.description: The number of overtime seconds carried over after defeating the boss.

updatetime.description: The timestamp when the record was updated.
